'''Ignacio Esteban''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[February 2001 Madrid tournament]] on 24 February 2001 with [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]] and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step with funky retrieval]], according to Angel San Jose's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1776">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-ithor-madrid-spain-feb-24-2001d1776/ ithor-madrid-spain-feb-24-2001], DeckTech (Angel "Dj" San Jose, 24 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-ithor-madrid-spain-feb-24-2001d1776/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
